body.message:
As per your request, please find below the 1-month rate for the 2-bedroom apartment at MAG318:

Rate: AED 12,000 for 30 nights
Refundable Security Deposit: AED 2,000

Please note that the refundable security deposit will be reimbursed within 7 to 14 working days after check-out, subject to a property inspection. The deposit will be refunded in full via credit card or bank transfer, provided there are no deductions for damages or other applicable charges.

Please also note that direct bookings are processed on a monthly basis only (30 nights per month).
